long_description: Applies variable selection once and executes all enclosed functions on the selected variable space until Variable Selection End.

messages.workflow_variable_selection_ga_frequency: GA frequency top-k encountered ties. Tie-break used: descending frequency, then ascending feature index.

warnings.workflow_variable_selection_default_looc: No enabled CV configuration was routed to Variable Selection Start. Defaulted to Stratified K-Fold when class labels are available, otherwise K-Fold, using CV Configuration defaults.
warnings.workflow_variable_selection_sfs_large_fe: SFS with a large feature space may require many evaluations. Consider narrowing feature_count_range or reducing variable count.
warnings.workflow_variable_selection_sfs_fallback: SFS used a deterministic fallback subset because candidate scoring was non-finite or tied during this step.
warnings.workflow_variable_selection_pls_proxy_cl: Selected method uses PLS-regression proxy scoring with numerically encoded class labels for n_class optimization. This is not a classification-native objective and may be sensitive to label encoding.
warnings.workflow_variable_selection_ga_frequency: GA frequency consensus with fewer than 3 executed restarts is unstable. Consider increasing GA Restarts or using Best Run consensus.

errors.workflow_variable_selection_first_order_: Variable Selection supports first-order data only (nway_flag must be 1).

layout.name: feature_count_range
layout.label: Feature Count Range
layout.tooltip: Numeric parser format, e.g. 5:2:25 or 5,10,15

layout.name: n_features_to_select
layout.label: Features to Select (Override Optimization)
layout.tooltip: Optional selected-count override. If provided, this count is always used downstream even when another count scores best; if outside Feature Count Range it is added.

layout.name: task_type
layout.label: Task Type
layout.tooltip: Choose explicit scoring/task family. Auto-detection is disabled.

layout.name: optimization_metric
layout.label: Optimization Metric
layout.tooltip: Objective metric used to optimize candidate variable subsets.

layout.name: selection_method
layout.label: Selection Method
layout.tooltip: Single method selector. Option list updates automatically by task type and optimization mode.

layout.name: one_class_reference_class
layout.label: One-Class Reference Class
layout.tooltip: Optional accepted class label for one-class optimization and nested one-class functions.

layout.name: one_class_unknown_label
layout.label: One-Class Unknown Label
layout.tooltip: Label used for non-reference/outlier class when one-class semantics are applied.

layout.name: optimize_for
layout.label: Optimize For
layout.tooltip: nested_function evaluates subsets using enclosed function outputs; surrogate_function uses sklearn surrogate scoring and runs enclosed functions once at the end.

layout.name: nested_cv_enabled
layout.label: Enable Nested CV
layout.tooltip: Optional outer cross-validation for variable-selection optimization. Uses outer-test metrics to select candidate models and writes them to CV trajectory outputs only.

layout.name: nested_cv_outer_strategy
layout.label: Outer CV Strategy
layout.tooltip: Splitter used for outer folds (performance estimation). Limited to strategies compatible with surrogate-model CV routing in this workflow.

layout.name: nested_cv_outer_splits
layout.label: Outer Splits
layout.tooltip: Number of outer folds/splits for K-Fold and Stratified K-Fold.

layout.name: nested_cv_outer_shuffle
layout.label: Outer Shuffle
layout.tooltip: Shuffle samples before creating outer K-Fold/Stratified K-Fold splits.

layout.name: nested_cv_outer_random_state
layout.label: Outer Random State
layout.tooltip: Seed for reproducible shuffled outer K-Fold/Stratified K-Fold splits.

layout.name: interval_width
layout.label: Interval Width
layout.tooltip: Interval width for interval-based selectors. Integer uses absolute variables; 0-1 uses fraction of total variables.

layout.name: ga_crossover_rate
layout.label: GA Crossover Rate
layout.tooltip: Probability of applying crossover when generating each child (0..1).

layout.name: ga_tournament_size
layout.label: GA Tournament Size
layout.tooltip: Parent-selection tournament size. Set to 1 for legacy elite-uniform parent selection.

layout.name: ga_n_restarts
layout.label: GA Restarts
layout.tooltip: Number of independent GA runs evaluated with the current optimization metrics

layout.name: ga_consensus_mode
layout.label: GA Consensus Mode
layout.tooltip: best_run: use best restart subset; frequency_top_k: rank by selection frequency and keep exactly k; frequency_threshold: keep all features with frequency >= threshold (selected count may differ from k).

layout.name: ga_patience_generations
layout.label: GA Patience (Generations)
layout.tooltip: Stop each GA restart early after this many generations without meaningful best-fitness improvement (0 disables).

layout.name: ga_max_evaluations
layout.label: GA Max Evaluations
layout.tooltip: Global cap for GA fitness evaluations per candidate count (0 disables).

layout.name: ga_min_improvement
layout.label: GA Min Improvement
layout.tooltip: Minimum best-fitness gain required to reset GA patience.

layout.name: ga_frequency_weighting
layout.label: GA Frequency Weighting
layout.tooltip: How restart frequencies are aggregated in frequency-based consensus modes: uniform gives each restart equal weight; score_weighted emphasizes higher-scoring restarts.

layout.name: ga_frequency_threshold
layout.label: GA Frequency Threshold
layout.tooltip: Applied only in Frequency Threshold mode. Keeps all variables whose restart frequency is >= threshold; if none pass, falls back to Best Run.

layout.name: selection_override_file_path
layout.label: Selection Override File
layout.tooltip: Optional .txt override file. When valid, selector algorithms are skipped and indices from file are applied.

layout.name: override_block_inputs
layout.label: Override Block Inputs
layout.tooltip: If enabled, enclosed functions consume selected X/axis data even if routed from earlier outputs

layout.name: nway_flag
layout.label: Data Dimensionality
layout.tooltip: Inherited from upstream data loading and required to enforce first-order-only variable selection.
